cards.text: The LORD is speaking to His people through Joel son of Pethuel (Joel 1:1). He has just promised them grain, new wine and oil, and said He'll repay them for the years the locusts ate (Joel 2:19-25). Then He keeps going: 'And afterward,' and friend, I'm leaning in like I just heard the oven timer.

cards.question: After promising all that grain and rain, what does the LORD say He'll pour out next?
When the LORD pours out His Spirit, He says it will be on ___ people.
When the LORD pours out His Spirit on all people, He says only the sons will prophesy and not the daughters.

cards.text: Then the LORD says, '…your old men will dream dreams, your young men will see visions.' Me? Years in the back of a junk drawer, and my only dream was somebody yelling, 'HEY, where's the cookie stamper?'
Then comes one little word: 'Even'. That's the boss saying, 'Everybody gets a bonus, EVEN the new guy,' and the new guy just stands there blinking like, 'Wait. ME?'

cards.question: The LORD says that in those days He'll pour out His Spirit even on whom?

cards.text: Now the LORD turns from people to the sky and the ground. He says He will show wonders in the heavens and on the earth: blood and fire and columns of smoke.
Then the LORD says the sun will be turned to darkness and the moon to blood.

cards.question: The sun goes dark and the moon turns to blood. The LORD says those signs come before what?

answers.text: The great and awesome Day of the LORD
The great harvest of the autumn rains
The return of the great locust army

cards.question: With that great and awesome Day coming, who will be saved?

answers.text: Everyone who calls on the name of the LORD
Everyone who was born inside Jerusalem
Everyone who never broke a single law

cards.text: Then a place is named: on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem there will be deliverance.

cards.question: The deliverance on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem will come as the LORD has promised.

cards.text: And that deliverance will be among the remnant called by the LORD. Later, Peter, one of Jesus' apostles, stands up in Jerusalem and says what's happening is what was spoken by the prophet Joel (Acts 2:14-16).
